summary: Set up passwordless SSH from node2 to node1, wrote a pull-based rsync sync script on node2 with a scoped NOPASSWD sudo rule for writing /etc/inventory/app.conf, and scheduled it via cron every 5 minutes (well inside the 15-minute requirement). Verified two independent end-to-end syncs (content and sha256 hash match) - one before and one after restarting both nodes. Performed the mandatory sequential node-restart protocol on node1 then node2, each with captured pre/post boot_id change, service health, and data/cron persistence proof.
actions_performed: Created /etc/inventory/app.conf on node1 as the source-of-truth config (path did not previously exist on either node)
Installed cluster SSH keypair for passwordless node2 -> node1 access, verified with a live ssh test
Created /home/antrieb/sync-inventory.sh on node2: rsync-pulls app.conf from node1 over SSH, only overwrites when content differs (via cmp), logs to /var/log/inventory-sync.log
Added scoped NOPASSWD sudoers rule (/etc/sudoers.d/inventory-sync) limited to cp/chmod on /etc/inventory/app.conf, validated with visudo -c
Installed a crontab entry on node2 running the sync script every 5 minutes
Verified sync end-to-end pre-restart: changed sync_version=2/change_marker=drift-test-1 on node1, confirmed cron auto-synced it to node2 within one 5-minute tick (hash match)
Captured healthy baseline (boot_id, active services, file hash) on both nodes
Restarted node1 via native reboot (backgrounded, ack returned before disconnect), polled until reachable, confirmed boot_id changed and sshd/data recovered
Restarted node2 via native reboot, polled until reachable, confirmed boot_id changed and cron/crontab/data recovered
Verified sync end-to-end post-restart: changed sync_version=3/change_marker=post-restart-test on node1, confirmed cron auto-synced it to node2 at the next tick (hash match 1ad3d306...)

evidence.requirement: node1 source-of-truth file /etc/inventory/app.conf exists and is authoritative
evidence.summary: Confirmed path absent, then created and populated the source file on node1.

evidence.requirement: Passwordless SSH access node2->node1 for sync mechanism
evidence.summary: Installed cluster keypair on both nodes and confirmed a live passwordless SSH login from node2 to node1's IP.

evidence.requirement: Sync mechanism installed (script, sudoers rule, cron schedule <=15 min)
evidence.summary: Created rsync-pull script, scoped sudoers rule (validated), and installed a */5 cron entry on node2; cron service confirmed active.
Manual run synced initial content; then changed node1 to sync_version=2/drift-test-1 and observed unattended cron sync completing by 14:05:01, well under 15 minutes.

evidence.requirement: Healthy baseline captured before any restart
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id, active service status, crontab, and matching file hashes on both nodes prior to any restart.

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: acknowledgement, changed boot identity, recovered service/data
evidence.summary: Reboot acknowledged pre-disconnect; connection refused mid-reboot; new boot_id f706011b... (was d08fb446...) with uptime 0; sshd active and source file intact post-restart.

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: acknowledgement, changed boot identity, recovered service/data/cron
evidence.summary: Reboot acknowledged pre-disconnect; connection refused mid-reboot; new boot_id f3be78f9... (was 74fd91b6...) with uptime 0; cron active, crontab persisted, synced file intact post-restart.

evidence.requirement: Sync mechanism functions correctly after both nodes restarted
evidence.summary: Changed node1 to sync_version=3/post-restart-test after both restarts; polled node2 and observed unattended cron sync at 14:10:01 with sha256 hash matching node1 exactly.
